values.binNote: TotalDamageEmpowered reads an unresolved calculation part (ByCharLevelFormulaCalculationPart) in the sheet; its values are inferred from the wiki's stated formula (50 to 220 by champion level) rather than confirmed against the bin row directly.

values.meaning: percentage of taken damage stored as grey health / healed
values.quote: '''Rengar''' stores 50% of the {{tt|post-mitigation damage|Damage calculated after modifiers}} he has taken in the last {{fd|1.5}} seconds as [[Health#Grey health|grey health]]

mechanics.claim: Battle Roar's active heals Rengar for the amount of grey health he has stored, which is 50% of post-mitigation damage taken in the last 1.5 seconds (100% from monster damage).
mechanics.quote: consuming his [[Health#Grey health|grey health]] to {{tip|heal}} himself

mechanics.claim: Grey health is not consumed at the moment of casting despite the visual, and only ever expires when its duration ends.
mechanics.quote: ''Grey health'' will not be consumed upon casting ''Battle Roar'' despite visually appearing so. It will only ever expire after its duration ends.

mechanics.claim: With Ferocity (empowered), Battle Roar's active damage is replaced by the higher Ferocity Bonus value and Rengar cleanses all crowd control on himself.
mechanics.quote: ''Battle Roar's'' damage is modified to deal {{pp|50 + (220-50)/17*(x-1) for 20|color=magic damage}} {{as|(+ 80% AP)}} {{as|magic damage}}. '''Rengar''' {{tip|cleanse|cleanses}} himself from all {{tip|crowd control}}.

mechanics.claim: Casting Battle Roar and its empowered version in quick succession can heal for 100% of recent damage taken.
mechanics.quote: If '''Rengar''' uses both ''Battle Roar'' and its empowered version in quick succession he will heal for 100% of the damage he received in the last few seconds.
